{{Top|leg}}
'''Shorn''' was an [[Color/Legends|orange-red]] edible [[Grain/Legends|grain]]. It was about 5 millimeters in diameter and was pea-shaped. It grew on stalks and was harvested seasonally. Most [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] grew [[Arcon Multinode Agricorp]] hybrid variety. Shorn was grown on the [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] of [[Orron III]].
